adjudication_records.issue_text: misc/theme-verifier/src/test/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessagePropertiesTest.java — getEnglishValue's MissingResourceException fallback path (key present in translation bundle but absent from the English bundle, defaulting englishValue to "") is never exercised by any test

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds getEnglishValue() which catches MissingResourceException and returns "" when a key is missing from the computed English bundle. All new/updated tests use fixtures where the corresponding *_en.properties file exists and contains the same key (e.g., noHtml_de -> noHtml_en, changedAnchor_de -> changedAnchor_en, illegalHtmlTag_en uses itself). There is no test fixture where a translation bundle contains a key absent from the English bundle, so the MissingResourceException fallback path is indeed not exercised.
